def write_table(self, **kwargs: Any) -> None:
        """
        |write_table| with Markdown table format.

        Args:
            flavor (Optional[str]):
                possible flavors are as follows (case insensitive):

                    - ``"CommonMark"``
                    - ``"gfm"``
                    - ``"github"`` (alias of ``"gfm"``)
                    - ``kramdown``
                    - ``Jekyll`` (alias of ``"kramdown"``)

                Defaults to ``"CommonMark"``.

        Example:
            :ref:`example-markdown-table-writer`

        .. note::
            - |None| values are written as an empty string
            - Vertical bar characters (``'|'``) in table items are escaped
        """

        if "flavor" in kwargs:
            new_flavor = normalize_md_flavor(kwargs["flavor"])
            if new_flavor != self.__flavor:
                self._clear_preprocess()
                self.__flavor = new_flavor

        if self.__flavor:
            self._styler = self._create_styler(self)

        with self._logger:
            try:
                self._verify_property()
            except EmptyTableDataError:
                self._logger.logger.debug("no tabular data found")
                return

            self.__write_chapter()
            self._write_table(**kwargs)
            if self.is_write_null_line_after_table:
                self.write_null_line()

[build-system]
build-backend = "setuptools.build_meta"
requires = [ "setuptools>=64", "setuptools_scm>=8",]

[project]
requires-python = ">=3.10"
name = "pytablewriter"
version = "0.1.0"

[tool.setuptools_scm]
version_scheme = "guess-next-dev"
local_scheme = "no-local-version"

[tool.black]
exclude = "/(\n      \\.eggs\n    | \\.git\n    | \\.mypy_cache\n    | \\.tox\n    | \\.venv\n    | \\.pytype\n    | _build\n    | buck-out\n    | build\n    | dist\n)/\n| docs/conf.py\n| setup.py\n"
line-length = 100
target-version = [ "py39", "py310", "py311", "py312", "py313",]

[tool.isort]
include_trailing_comma = true
known_third_party = [ "elasticsearch", "pandas", "pathvalidate", "pytablereader", "pytest", "simplejson", "sphinx_rtd_theme", "sqliteschema", "tabledata", "typepy", "typing_extensions", "yaml",]
line_length = 100
lines_after_imports = 2
multi_line_output = 3
skip_glob = [ "*/.eggs/*", "*/.pytype/*", "*/.tox/*",]

[tool.mypy]
ignore_missing_imports = true
python_version = 3.9
pretty = true
check_untyped_defs = true
disallow_incomplete_defs = true
disallow_untyped_defs = true
no_implicit_optional = true
show_error_codes = true
show_error_context = true
warn_redundant_casts = true
warn_unreachable = true
warn_unused_configs = true
warn_unused_ignores = true

[tool.pyright]
exclude = [ "**/node_modules", "**/__pycache__", ".tox", ".venv", "_build", "_sandbox", "build", "dist",]
pythonVersion = "3.9"

[tool.ruff]
line-length = 100
target-version = "py39"
exclude = [ ".eggs/", ".tox/", "_sandbox/*", "build/", "docs/conf.py",]

[tool.coverage.run]
branch = true
source = [ "pytablewriter",]

[tool.coverage.report]
exclude_lines = [ "except ImportError", "raise NotImplementedError", "pass", "ABCmeta", "abstractmethod", "warnings.warn",]
omit = []
precision = 1
show_missing = true

[tool.pytest.ini_options]
testpaths = [ "test",]
md_report = true
md_report_color = "auto"
md_report_verbose = 0
discord_verbose = 0

[tool.poetry.dependencies]
icontract = "^2.7.1"

[tool.poetry.group.dev.dependencies]
pytest = "^8.4.2"
pytest-cov = "^7.0.0"
pytest-reportlog = "^0.4.0"
pytest-env = "^1.2.0"
dataproperty = "^1.1.0"
pathvalidate = "^3.3.1"
pytablereader = "^0.31.4"
tabledata = "^1.3.4"
elasticsearch = "^9.2.0"
tcolorpy = "^0.1.7"
typepy = "^1.3.4"
toml = "^0.10.2"
pyyaml = "^6.0.3"
pandas = "^2.3.3"
simplejson = "^3.20.2"
sqliteschema = "^2.0.1"
referencing = "<0.28"
